claim_ceiling: TF-IDF formal suite at 174k complete with frozen protocol; two-mode tradeoff reproduced; citation heritage validated but underpowered; v17b normalization shows signal-type divergence; dense embeddings (3/26 years) fail adversarial gates; lane blocked on legal-distance 174k dense embeddings delivery
evidence_summary: 8 TF-IDF representations evaluated on 12 frozen benchmarks at 174k scale with exact k-NN (HNSW artifact fixed). 5/8 PASS both adversarial gates (LangDom<0.85, Jurist>0.5): cited_decisions_tfidf (0.53/0.80), outcome_tfidf (0.45/0.73), regeste_tfidf (0.48/0.61), cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (0.52/0.81), cited_outcome_hybrid_0.7 (0.52/0.80). 3/8 FAIL both gates: full_text_tfidf_light (1.00/0.00), regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.5/0.7 (1.00/0.00). Citation heritage: 2,019/2,105 resolved, 0.1% coverage, all FAIL recall@10>0.2 despite AUC up to 0.898. v17b normalization: citation-based reps +3-8% purity gains (reproduces v17b); text-based reps -30-34% zoom_fine degradation. Dense embeddings (2000-2002, ~12,570 decisions): center_projected 64/128/768 all FAIL (LangDom~0.98, Jurist~0.04). Legal-distance 174k dense: 3/26 years ACCEPTED (7.2%). All negative results preserved, limitations explicitly acknowledged, no overclaiming, no leakage/gaming detected.
